internal.title: High Kafka Consumer Lag Impacting Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 10:12 UTC, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag on the accounting service. Diagnosis confirmed a backlog in Kafka message consumption, with consumer lag reaching 5200 records and p95 latency elevated at 5.2 seconds. Multiple remediation proposals were blocked by guardrails, preventing immediate resolution. The incident was escalated for further investigation and mitigation.

Timeline highlights:
- 10:12:59: Alert received for KafkaConsumerLagHigh
- 10:32:41: Diagnosis round 1 confirmed queue backlog
- 10:32:46: Proposal to enable failure flag refused by guardrails
- 10:32:53: Diagnosis round 2 confirmed queue backlog
- 10:32:57: Proposal refused due to missing dry run and invalid rollback
- 10:33:07: Diagnosis round 3 confirmed queue backlog
- 10:33:12: Proposal refused again by guardrails

Root cause analysis is ongoing due to blocked remediation actions. Further updates will follow.

Our engineering team identified the issue and is actively working on resolving it. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience.
